profile.name: desktop-webgl
profile.routeGeometry: multipart; absence of source A/B annotations is intentional

issues.description: The transparent desktop legend uses muted text directly on dark relief, making its line sample, direction key and access hint difficult to read.
issues.cssCause: map-polish.css supplies --muted; map-detail.css gives an opaque --surface backing only when data-map-imagery is satellite.
issues.proposedScopedFix: Generalize the existing .atlas-wrap[data-map-imagery=satellite] .map-legend backing rule to .atlas-wrap .map-legend, preserving all declarations and mobile display:none rules.
issues.fixStateAtReview: proposal sent to parent; no CSS edited by reviewer at report creation

remediation.change: Generalized existing opaque satellite legend rule to .atlas-wrap .map-legend.
remediation.parentPreviewObservation: Root reports HMR paper background rgb(255,254,250), forest text, 34px legend height and no control/source-caption overlap in desktop Leaflet fallback. Reviewer did not independently operate that preview.

positiveChecks: No detected overlap between context, style switch, map controls, source credits, layer button and left panel in the 23 reviewed frames.
No clipped UI text in the reviewed frames; viewport-edge basemap labels naturally clip.
Source line has legible light halo in route-fit, detailed 11.91/14.91 and satellite 11/14 frames.
Satellite image age is absent in all six satellite frames; source credit remains visible.
Saved overview consistently discloses limited boundary detail; close zooms show overview-without-details caption.
limitations: The workflow stopped at its 12-minute budget. Native terrain z11/14/18, independent prepared 3D scene and short-source endpoints were not captured on desktop.
At z18 the fixed camera is between branches of this multipart route. These frames do not prove selected-line appearance at maximum zoom.
These screenshots do not establish physical-device performance, FPS or successful completion of all desktop audit gates.
Candidate7 uses pre-fix runtime. The mobile stale-relief palette issue and native-pan final-caption proof require new candidate8 browser evidence.
Satellite network audit records 304 finished image responses and 2 failed responses; six screenshot frames contain imagery, but this is not a claim of zero network failures.
